L31·N10989unmasked layer
Fires on separator/prefix characters embedded in long numeric identifiers — the "." in a phone number, "/" in a patent serial number, "-" before a post ID, the ₹ before an amount, digit groups in GPS coordinates — i.e. the token position that continues a numeric string (with a couple of stray hits on filler boilerplate); it is suppressed by ordinary function words ("then", "by", "should", "can") in filler prose.
